name: South Alabama Comic Con
blurb: A comics and pop-culture convention at the Mobile Convention Center in Mobile, Alabama, with celebrity guests, cosplay and a family-friendly atmosphere.
notes: The seed's 'Oct 3-4, 2026' date is confirmed by the site (page title 'South Alabama Comic Con | October 3 & 4, 2026 | Mobile Convention Center', and Tickets/FAQ text 'South Alabama Comic Con will take place October 3rd & 4th 2026') but that show ran immediately before this 2026-10-05 check date, so it falls outside the window and is not listed as an edition. No 2027 (or any later) date has been posted yet anywhere on the site (unlike sibling VXV site Iron City Comic Con, which already names '2027' without a specific date) — Tickets and FAQ both still only describe the just-finished Oct 2026 show. Same VXV/Wix template as Iron City Comic Con: the homepage carousel's 'NWA Comic Con' slide and the generic 'Photo Ops Example.png' are shared cross-site assets, not this con's own art, so the og:image (consistent across home/tickets/FAQ) is used for cover instead.
